steps.title: Locate base
instructions: Locate the next working area.
Start with the base in the shown orientation.
Locate the controller and actuator mounting areas.

steps.title: Fit controller
instructions: Move to the next working face.
Align the four board holes with the base supports.
Check that the board rests evenly on its supports.

steps.title: Secure controller
instructions: Move to the next working face.
Insert the screws on this side.
Check that all shown fasteners are seated.

steps.title: Fit base actuator
instructions: Move to the next working face.
Align the actuator case with the mounting frame.
Check the actuator seating and horn orientation.

steps.title: Secure base actuator
instructions: Move to the next working face.
Insert the underside screws. Base shown translucent for visibility.
Check the recessed fasteners. The translucent base is an explanatory view.
